 For the Nhai : Ms. Soni Shrivastava, Advocate

======================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Partha Sarthy
 Oral Order

Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned counsel for the State and learned counsel for the National Highway Authority of India (NHAI).
Learned counsel for the petitioner contends that the petitioner has not been paid amount of compensation against acquisition of his land by the competent authority-cum-DLAO, Kaimur at Bhabhua in L.A. Case no.22/2020-21.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that an application filed by the petitioner under section 10(B) of the Mutation Act which was registered as Case no.850/1977-78, the Chakbandi Officer allowed the same by his order dated 28.4.1978.
Pursuant thereto necessary corrections were made in the khatiyan, copy of which has been brought on record at page 35 to the writ application.
The petitioner started paying rent and rent receipts were granted Patna High Court CWJC No.16032 of 2022(4) dt.20-04-2023 vide Annexure-2 series.

Learned counsel further submits that three revision cases including Revision Case no.8 of 2014 of the State of Bihar was preferred under section 35 of the Act and all the three cases were rejected vide order dated 5.10.2017 (Annexure-4) passed by the Joint Director, Consolidation.
The State of Bihar accepted the said order and did not challenge the same before any higher forum.
So far as others are concerned, they filed B.L.T. Case no.656 of 2018 and 657 of 2018 wherein besides the petitioner, the State of Bihar was also made opposite party.

entities.text: B.L.T. Case no.656 of 2018 and 657 of 2018
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: The learned Tribunal by order dated 5.8.2021 dismissed the said application.

It may be noted here that once again neither the private respondents who were petitioners before the Bihar Land Tribunal nor the State of Bihar who was O.P. no.1 in the Tribunal challenged the said order.

Learned counsel for the petitioner referring to the letter dated Surendra Ram vs The Project Director on 20 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/191210327/
1 10.3.2022 submits that DLAO directed the Circle Officer to carry out measurement which was carried out by the Circle Officer and this report was sent back vide letter dated 21.4.2022 (Annexure-9).

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the NHAI submits that from perusal of the counter affidavit filed on behalf of the NHAI, it would transpire that the gazette notification under section 3A of the National Highways Act was published on 12.4.2010 and Patna High Court CWJC No.16032 of 2022(4) dt.20-04-2023 under section 3D of the Act on 8.4.2011.

In response, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that inspite of the order dated 28.4.1978 (Annexure-3) leading to appropriate correction in the khatiyan wherein the name of the petitioner was entered, nevertheless the award which was prepared by the DLAO and which has been brought on record as Annexure-6 to the application, the respondent authorities still showed the land in question as belonging to the State.

Further, soon after the matter was decided by the Bihar Land Tribunal on 5.8.2021, immediately thereafter on 13.8.2021, the petitioner filed a representation/objection before the DLAO, Kaimur at Bhabhua which led to the direction being issued to the Circle Officer and resulting in measurement of the land in question.

No appeal has been preferred by the State Government against the order dated 5.10.2017 (Annexure-4) as also the order dated 5.8.2021 (Annexure-5) and in the khatiyan the name of the petitioner stands corrected pursuant to the order passed in the year 1978 itself.

Let the DLAO, Kaimur at Bhabhua who also happens to be the Competent Authority under the NHAI Act file his further affidavit as to the order passed by him on the representation/objection of the petitioner as contained in Patna High Court CWJC No.16032 of 2022(4) dt.20-04-2023 Annexure-7.
Put up after ten days.
(Partha Sarthy, J) Saurabh/-
